title: Declare result shapes for read tools and check them at the tool boundary
goal: A malformed tool result never reaches the planner
acceptance: Each built-in read tool has a declared result shape next to its descriptor
A result that does not match is refused with an error naming the tool and field
Join test across planner, gate and executor with a valid and a malformed result
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20 from the Agentica review. Not a measurement.
